speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please describe the specific nature of your gait and limb ataxia, and when did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of multiple sclerosis, stroke, or exposure to toxic substances like heavy metals? Have you noticed any changes in your speech, vision, or coordination that worsen after physical activity?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Natalizumab is associated with a serious risk of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML), which presents with focal neurological deficits like your right-sided ataxia. I need to rule this out immediately. REQUEST TEST: Brain_MRI

text: The MRI findings confirm Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy. I will immediately discontinue the natalizumab and initiate plasma exchange to remove the drug from your system. DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)
